name: artha-mesh
description: Indic multilingual meeting interpretation — Track B

scripts.dev:server: uv run --project server uvicorn artha_mesh.main:app --app-dir server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --no-access-log --log-level warning
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && node scripts/copy-dist.mjs
scripts.test:server: uv run --project server --extra dev pytest server/tests -q
scripts.test: npm run test:conference-runtime && npm run test:web && npm run test:server
scripts.format: prettier --write web/src scripts/*.mjs docs/*.md README.md package.json compose.yaml
